connector.name: WoopSocial Social Media MCP
connector.registryDescription: Post to social media (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok, X/Twitter and more)
connector.summary: Hosted at api.woopsocial.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.woopsocial, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional authorization header value in the format: Bearer <your WoopSocial API key>. Only needed if your MCP client does not support OAuth either via CIMD or DCR.
